baseline_models.focus_anchor: الجنة at 79:41:2 and المأوى at 79:41:4, joined by the emphatic identity frame فإن ... هي.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tree-veiled garden supplies an enclosing habitat, while ma'wa supplies joining a gathering shelter; the identity frame presents that enclosure as the definitive destination.

activation_trace.role: The tree-screened garden contributes the enclosing habitat in which the destination takes form.
Joining a side that gathers and houses contributes reception and settled belonging.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is simply the place one goes.
changed_reading.after: Paradise is the definitive enclosing habitat into which one is gathered and housed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired roots of الجنة and المأوى at 79:41:2,4 permit protective and compassionate side-branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The protective shield branch of j-n-n and the pity/mercy branch of hamz-w-y converge on an abode whose reception protects rather than merely locates.

activation_trace.role: The warding shield image supplies active protection to the garden's enclosure.
Tenderness and mercy supply a compassionate mode of receiving the one sheltered.

changed_reading.before: The abode is a neutral residence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the abode is a mercifully receiving shield as well as a residence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Severe shaking opens a field of instability; mountains are then fixed and the Hour is asked about as a mooring. Against that field, ma'wa reads as the stable berth where movement finally gathers and stops.

activation_trace.role: Severe disturbance supplies the unstable field against which refuge becomes anchorage.
Fixity and rooted stability supply the first stabilizing pole in the sequence.
A ship stopping at its mooring supplies the berth image transferred to final settlement.
Gathering into a shelter anchors the berth image in the focus predicate.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from the first severe shaking (79:6), through mountains made firm (79:32), to the question of the Hour's mooring (79:42).
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disturbance, fixity, mooring, and gathered shelter; I supply the arrow that ma'wa functions as a berth after instability. A live alternative is only a general contrast between transience and permanence.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is a permanent residence after the event.
changed_reading.after: Paradise is the terminal anchorage that receives its people after cosmic and temporal instability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water, pasture, firm anchoring, and enjoyed provision form a compact habitat-making sequence. The focus garden plus gathering abode concentrates those functions into a final protected habitability rather than an abstract location.

activation_trace.role: Water supplies the life-bearing material of the habitat sequence.
Pasture supplies vegetated sustenance that resonates with the focus garden.
Fixity supplies the stable substrate required by a lasting habitat.
Enjoyable benefit supplies the habitat's use and delight rather than bare survival.
The tree-covered garden gathers vegetation, enclosure, and delight into the focus noun.
The gathering abode turns the ecological materials into a received dwelling.

structural_cues: Ayat 79:30-33 consecutively outfit earth with expanse, water, pasture, anchoring mountains, and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered habitat-making sequence and the focus's garden/refuge pair; I infer the sequence previews the functional architecture of the final abode. Alternatively, it may establish creative power without prefiguring Paradise.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is an unspecified otherworldly garden.
changed_reading.after: Paradise gathers the surah's water, vegetation, stability, and beneficial enjoyment into perfected protected habitability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hell is exposed and then occupies the exact ma'wa identity frame later occupied by the garden. Ma'wa therefore names final allocation rather than comfort by itself; blazing Hell or the concealed garden determines the destination's quality.

activation_trace.role: Manifest exposure supplies a visibility pole opposite the focus root's covering image.
Intensely blazing fire specifies one possible quality of the otherwise shared final abode.
The same gathering-abode branch in Hell proves that ma'wa alone does not guarantee comfort.
Covering and concealment specify the sheltering quality of the focus destination.
The repeated gathering-abode branch marks Paradise as the contrasting allocation.

structural_cues: 79:39 and 79:41 repeat فإن ... هي المأوى with only الجحيم and الجنة exchanged.
79:36 exposes Hell before the paired destinations are assigned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax, blazing fire, exposure, and the covered focus noun; I infer that ma'wa is a morally specified destination category. The exposure/concealment polarity may be secondary, but the syntactic contrast remains.

changed_reading.before: Ma'wa itself denotes a compassionate safe haven.
changed_reading.after: Ma'wa denotes inevitable final reception; Paradise's garden makes that reception sheltering, while Hell makes the same finality consuming.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preferred near/lower life and the self's inclination, with a live falling branch, form a downward or short-range trajectory. Standing before the Lord and checking that inclination reverse the motion; ma'wa becomes gathered settlement at the end of restraint.

activation_trace.role: The world as nearer/lower supplies the short-range horizon that is preferred.
Standing or staying in a station supplies a stable positional counterweight to inclination.
Checking and restraining supplies the intervention that arrests the self's motion.
The self's desire as inclination supplies the motive trajectory being checked.
The side-branch of falling into a depth spatializes the risk carried by unchecked inclination.
Joining a gathering shelter supplies the settled counter-trajectory in the focus.

structural_cues: The paired فأما clauses in 79:37-41 attach opposed orientations to opposed ma'wa outcomes, and 79:41 is the result of 79:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lower nearness, inclination/fall, station, restraint, and settlement; I supply the causal-spatial arrow from checked inclination to gathered abode. The fall image may remain an etymological echo rather than an active metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Paradise follows fear and self-restraint as an external reward.
changed_reading.after: Paradise is the settled counter-trajectory to near and downward self-inclination: checked motion ends in gathered abode.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a hydrological side-branch of n-h-y into an eschatological abode. It remains anchored because 79:44 names the Hour's terminus with that root while 79:41 names a gathering shelter. Render only as a material analogy, not as lexical equivalence or a claim that Paradise is literally a basin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المأوى at 79:41:4 as a place that gathers and holds, with الجنة at 79:41:2 as its enclosing habitat.

activation_trace.role: Water settling where a flood ends supplies the terminal-catchment material image.
Sufficiency that ends further seeking supplies completion rather than mere arrival.
Joining a gathering shelter keeps the catchment analogy attached to the focus abode.
The enclosed garden contains the exploratory endpoint image within a habitable focus noun.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Paradise is a terminal catchment: dispersed movement is received, held, and made sufficient at the end of the flow.

strongest_changes: The exact 79:39/79:41 predicate frame makes ma'wa an assigned final destination, not intrinsically a merciful refuge.
Hawa as inclination/fall and ma'wa as gathered settlement turn ethical restraint into a counter-trajectory.
R-s-w firmness and mooring turn Paradise into anchorage across cosmic instability.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's concealment/gathering pair was activated by exposure, habitat-making, mooring, and endpoint branches; the same ma'wa construction for Hell forced a genuine baseline revision.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether exposure versus concealment is an active polarity or only branch-level sharpening.
Whether the ecological sequence prefigures Paradise or only demonstrates creative power.
Whether the fall image in h-w-y and catchment image in n-h-y should remain material analogies.
